'''Nemaris''' is the wife of a soldier in [[Gareth Bryne]]'s army.

==Activities==
After learning that [[Egwene al'Vere]] had been captured by the [[White Tower]], [[Siuan Sanche]] needed a horse to quickly inform the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]]. Nemaris' husband lets Siuan use [[Nightlily]], who is a mild horse but not as mild as [[Bela]].{{ref/book|11|1}}
